context: Applied contracts 3.0.0-draft.3 and the merge-time fixes: scopeAuthorizes adopted, optional superseded.by, legacy post entry_type, new delivery reasons, exchangeStatus on the store API, RetrievalAnnex moved, correctionFor conflicts, gitignore, offline switch, calibration script, doc counts.
rationale: src/server.ts calls createTwiningContext(projectRoot) with no options, so the MCP server read only the caller and ignored both the environment and the config — an operator who had said 'never download a model' still got a download attempt on first use (DN25). Each source answers a different question: the caller ('this process must not use the network' — the CLI), the environment ('this shell has no network' — Codex, CI), the config ('this installation never downloads'). OR is right because offline is strictly the more conservative mode, so offline:false must not override an operator's TWINING_OFFLINE=1. TWINING_OFFLINE parses only 1/true/yes as affirmative, so exporting it empty is not a switch. embeddings.offline had to be added to DEFAULT_CONFIG as well: deepMerge iterates the DEFAULTS' keys, so a config key absent from DEFAULT_CONFIG is silently dropped.
summary: The offline switch is the OR of caller option, TWINING_OFFLINE and config embeddings.offline, resolved once in createTwiningContext
